A Drow sorceress, late twenties woman, in obsidian-black velvet robes with a silver crystal harness at her chest, violet glowing tattoos spiraling up both forearms, wild-magic aureole of crackling purple light surrounding her as she releases a bolt of raw arcane force inside a vaulted hall of floating rune-stones.

A Tiefling warlock, mid-thirties man, in black-and-violet pact-bound robes with a deep cowl pushed back, a fel-pact amulet burning amber at his sternum, curved obsidian horns etched with binding-runes, casting a swirling vortex of eldritch green smoke between his outstretched palms beneath a grand arcane-hall chandelier.

A High Elf archmage, fifties woman, in deep-indigo velvet mage-robes with silver constellation embroidery along every seam, glowing-rune cuffs of mithril at both wrists, white hair bound in a jeweled clasp, levitating three inches above mosaic floor tiles while a galaxy of arcane sigils orbits her raised staff.

A Firbolg druid, forties man, in leaf-and-fur layered druid-robes of earthy brown and forest green, a staff wrapped in living vines that bloom as he casts, a glowing green aura radiating from both hands, antler-tipped wooden charms braided into his long grey-streaked hair inside a mossy-walled inner sanctum.

A Gnome runic-scribe, thirties woman, in a many-pocketed scribe-coat of charcoal wool, brass-rim spectacles perched on her nose, ink-stained fingers tracing glowing runes onto a hovering scroll, a stuffed leather satchel at her hip, surrounded by shelves of luminescent tomes in a towering arcane-hall library.

A Half-Orc battle-mage, late twenties man, in a sigil-engraved iron breastplate over midnight-blue caster robes, one gauntlet removed to free the casting hand which blazes with amber rune-light, a glowing-runic blade sheathed at his back, crouched in combat stance on the steps of a grand conjuration chamber.

An Aasimar cleric, late forties woman, in cream-and-gold ceremonial robes with a radiant sun-disc holy symbol at her collar, blessed-cord-bound regalia draping her arms, soft golden radiance spilling from her open palms as she channels a healing benediction beneath the rose-window of a sanctified arcane-hall nave.

A Shadar-Kai necromancer, thirties woman, in bone-buttoned dark-grey scholar-robes belted with a cord of carved ivory links, a skull-pendant of polished onyx at her throat, glowing-rune-stones arrayed in a circle on the flagstone floor around her, cool silver light leaking from her eyes as she reverently raises a spectral spirit.

A Dwarf elementalist, forties man, in fire-orange robes with ember-red sash and soot-dark cuffs, a flame-bound staff of blackened iron in one hand, jets of living fire threading between his thick fingers, broad beard singed at the tips and held back with a copper clasp inside a heat-shimmered summoning vault.

A Wood Elf hedgewitch, early thirties woman, in layered shawls of hand-dyed wool in sage and rust, bone-and-crystal necklaces stacked at her collarbone, herb-pouches tied at her belt, a witch-amulet of knotted silver wire glowing faintly, whispering an incantation over a bubbling iron vessel in a low-arched alcove lined with hanging dried herbs.

A Dragonborn mage, late twenties woman, bronze-scaled with amber eyes, in deep-teal velvet mage-robes edged with gold rune-embroidery, gemmed star-sapphire staff held aloft, glowing-rune cuffs bright at her wrists, conjuring an expanding lattice of arcane light across the vaulted ceiling of a grand arcane hall as loose scrolls spiral around her.

A Genasi sorcerer, mid-thirties man, water-aspected with skin that shimmers like moonlit ocean, in dark-blue velvet robes with a sea-glass crystal harness, glowing tidal-rune tattoos visible along his neck and hands, a cascade of conjured water arcing in a perfect crescent around him inside a domed hall of mirrored stone.

A Tabaxi warlock, late twenties woman, spotted tawny fur and luminous green eyes, in black-and-violet pact-bound robes with a slit hood, a fel-pact amulet of carved jet at her chest, eldritch violet flame wreathing both hands as she presses a pact-seal into a hovering obsidian mirror inside an arched sanctum.

A Sea Elf cleric, forties man, with pale-blue-green skin and fin-edged ears, in flowing teal-and-silver ceremonial robes with a trident holy symbol woven in pearls at his chest, blessed-cord-bound sleeves trailing, radiant aquamarine light pouring from his raised hands as he calls a tidal benediction inside a hall of vaulted sea-glass windows.

A Human runic-scribe, late fifties man, in a deep-brown scribe-coat with a double row of brass buttons and deep side pockets, brass-rim spectacles on his nose, ink-stained fingers guiding a quill that etches self-illuminating runes into a suspended vellum sheet, leather scroll-satchel open at his feet in a candlelit lore-hall.

A Goliath elementalist, early thirties woman, with grey-marble skin and jagged stone-pattern tattoos, in earth-brown robes layered over a stone-grey jerkin, an earth-bound staff of carved granite in both hands, shards of levitating rock orbiting her in a slow ring as emerald ground-light pulses from her feet on the hall's flagstone floor.

A Forest Gnome illusionist, early twenties woman, with mossy-brown hair pinned with tiny silver star-clips, in layered robes of dove-grey and soft violet with mirrored-glass buttons, casting both hands wide to unfurl a shimmering panorama of duplicate selves across an arcane-hall gallery, her true form visible only by the single teal spark at her brow.

A Dunmer battle-mage, mid-forties man, with ash-grey skin and crimson eyes, in a sigil-engraved dark-steel breastplate over charcoal robes, one bare casting hand blazing with red rune-light, a glowing-runic blade half-drawn at his hip, striding through a conjuration chamber where arcane wards crack and flare at his passing.

A Halfling sorceress, early twenties woman, with warm-brown skin and curly copper hair, in deep-plum velvet robes with a crystal-shard harness glittering at her sternum, wild-magic aura of gold and rose sparks erupting around her small frame, both hands raised as an uncontrolled surge of raw sorcery blooms across the hall's arched ceiling.

An Orc necromancer, late thirties man, in bone-buttoned slate-grey scholar-robes with wide cuffs, a polished-bone skull-pendant at his collar, glowing-rune-stones laid in a careful grid at his feet, dark-green skin faintly lit by cold violet radiance as he calmly recites a binding litany over a hovering spectral form in a stone-vaulted crypt-hall.

A High Elf druid, late fifties woman, silver-haired with bark-brown eyes, in leaf-and-fur layered druid-robes of deep amber and midnight green, a staff of living hazel-wood wreathed in tiny white blossoms, a glowing green aura rising from her palms as she calls a canopy of spectral branches to spread across the hall's stone ceiling.

A Tiefling archmage, forties woman, with violet skin and two elegantly curved horns wound with thin gold wire, in midnight-blue velvet mage-robes heavy with silver constellation embroidery, gemmed staff of electrum clutched in one hand, glowing-rune cuffs flickering as she suspends a dozen open spell-tomes in a rotating arc above a grand lectern.

A Dwarf hedgewitch, mid-forties woman, with auburn braids threaded with bone-charms, in layered shawls of oatmeal and forest-green dyed wool, bone-and-crystal necklaces at her collar, herb-pouches clustered at both hips, a knotted-silver witch-amulet glowing warm amber as she stirs a slow enchantment over a hearthstone vessel in a low-arched hall alcove.

A Firbolg cleric, early thirties man, towering and broad with pale-grey skin and soft cow-like eyes, in ivory-and-sage ceremonial robes bearing a carved oak holy symbol, blessed-cord-bound regalia crossing his wide chest, warm golden radiance flooding from his open hands as he quietly blesses a circle of arcane-inscribed stone in a vaulted sanctuary.

A Genasi battle-mage, late twenties woman, air-aspected with translucent skin laced with faint lightning-blue veins, in a sigil-engraved silver breastplate over wind-grey robes, one bare hand erupting in crackling static-rune light, a glowing-runic short-blade raised in her other hand, hair streaming in a self-generated gale inside a pillared arcane-hall arena.

A Drow sorceress, late-twenties woman, in obsidian-black velvet robes with violet-crystal harness across her chest, silver glowing tattoos coiling up her bare forearms, white hair swept into a loose braid; she stands at the center of a grand arcane hall, hands raised, wild-magic aura crackling in spiraling indigo light around her.

A Tiefling warlock, mid-thirties man, in black-and-violet pact-bound robes with a fel-pact amulet resting on his sternum, curved horns banded with iron rings, glowing rune-tattoos burning amber along his jaw; he presses one palm against a towering rune-carved pillar, dark-velvet cape billowing as eldritch energy pours from his fingers.

A Dwarf runic-scribe, forties woman, in a deep-green scribe-coat heavy with brass-buckled pockets, brass-rim spectacles perched on her broad nose, ink-stained fingers gripping a rune-etched quill; she hovers mid-transcription before a vast illuminated tome floating at chest height inside a vaulted arcane library, the air shimmering with copied-glyph light.

A Firbolg druid, mid-thirties man, in layered leaf-and-fur druid-robes with a living-vine-bound staff clutched in one enormous hand, an animal-pelt cloak draped over wide shoulders, glowing green aura rising off his skin; he kneels on the mosaic floor of a grand magical hall, coaxing a bloom of spectral forest growth from the stone.

A High Elf archmage, fifties woman, in floor-length deep-sapphire velvet mage-robes with silver constellation embroidery at every hem, glowing-rune cuffs sealed at her wrists, white-streaked silver hair coiled under a gem-studded circlet; she traces a luminous orbital pattern in the air with her gemmed staff inside a domed celestial-mapped chamber.
